title: Cuff Craft
summary: A playable bio-quest demo: meet through effort, not a swipe.

blocks.title: The bio is the quest giver.
blocks.body: No pickup line. No swipe queue. A little thought opens a different kind of door.

blocks.heading: Do the quest. Earn the conversation.
blocks.description: The Quest Giver sets the challenge. You are the Seeker: answer with specifics, then let them decide whether to open the conversation.

blocks.title: A quest opens a door, not a right to someone.
blocks.body: The Giver decides whether to accept your introduction. This demo lets you try both sides. The local grader checks length, repetition, filler, and details, but cannot judge sincerity or detect AI-written answers. No message leaves this page, no account is needed, and nothing is saved after you reload.

blocks.heading: Writing first. The world later.
blocks.body: This is the smallest loop: profile, quest, introduction, consent, conversation. Local scavenger hunts and real-world loot could follow. This demo does not promise prizes, real matches, or a live dating service.
